entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, yes... I need to return my VeloBand. I... I just don't understand it. It feels so hard to use.
I'm sorry to hear you're finding it difficult. I can certainly look into return options for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. The whole menu system is just so confusing. I read the user manual, but honestly, I expected more from it. It's just... a lot. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm here to help. Let me just pull up that order... Okay, I see it here. It looks like it was delivered 22 days ago, on December 15th. Is that correct?
Yes, that sounds right. I'm so sorry, is that too late? I didn't really understand the policy when I bought it.
Not a problem at all. Let me just double-check our return eligibility for you. One moment... Yes, our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the timeframe.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! Thank you so much.

You are very welcome. I have just initiated that return in our system. I'm sending an email to you right now with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just place the device back in its original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at the post office.
That's perfect. You've been a great help, Sarah.
It's my pleasure. Once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
